name: multitq_kpct_k0_registration
state_at_registration: No P_0 or G_0 generation exists; no dev_sel2000 or test score of any k = 0 arm has been computed or read. Both GPUs are held by the guided track's LoRA arms; this registration was made in a CPU-only preparation stage. A CPU plumbing dry run (5 dev_sel2000 questions, placeholder answers, stand-in generations; scores 0 by construction) is the only execution so far.

P_0.what: k = 0, training-free: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (bf16, vLLM tensor-parallel 2 on both cards) few-shot JSON parser + our operators + RULE ordering; no re-ranker

prompt_designs.check: the three registered designs are used unchanged: the k0 copies of p0_prompts.py, pk_common.py, p0_execute.py, p0_infer_70b.py, p0_exemplars.json and p0_prompts/* are byte-identical to the parser track's CODE_MANIFEST.json and to the files on the GPU host (sha256 compared)

exemplars.disclosure: forming the 8 (qtype, answer_type) cells read the qtype and answer_type fields of all train questions; question text of exactly these 8 was read; parses hand-written; the 8 answers were consulted afterwards for verification (8/8 execute to gold under k0)

P_0.decoding: greedy, max 160 new tokens, seed 0; logprobs of sampled tokens recorded (diagnostic; P_0 has no tau)
P_0.execution: p0_execute.py (parser track, unchanged): exact KG name else base linker (stemming, demonyms; no sector aliases, no block list, no train statistics); k0 executor = operators + retrieval + RULE ordering, no re-ranker; invalid JSON / unknown name -> empty list (a miss); Hits@10 padding from KG statistics only (executor models/k0/FB.json)
P_0.selection: best dev_sel2000 Hits@1 (hit count); tie -> shortest prompt (registered chars: d1 12,118 < d2 13,272 < d3 13,675)

G_0.what: k = 0: the same 70B, zero-shot (no exemplars, no training), guided by P_0's bundle (P_0 parse, top-20 RULE-ordered candidates with RULE ranks, no S scores; 20 supporting facts; operator trace); generates the answer string

prompt_designs.head_note: g1's instruction is the registered G_k head gk_common.G_HEAD unchanged (sha256 67d08028..., as in amendment B1)
prompt_designs.layout: registered G_k layout (Question; Parse; Candidates; Facts grouped losslessly by (subject, relation, object) with chronological dates; Operator trace) with the S-score column removed (k = 0 has no re-ranker): candidate | RULE rank | satisfies operator | supporting facts
prompt_designs.g2: g1 + fixed glossary of the bundle fields and the date-granularity convention
prompt_designs.g3: g2 + fixed closing decision instruction ending 'Answer:'
prompt_designs.status: written and fixed by sha256 in this CPU stage, before any G_0 (or P_0) generation or dev_sel2000 score

bundle.source: P_0's selected design: its mapped compact parses (p0_execute.py parse_used) -> compact_to_parse(c, question, None) -> rec_info_from_parse -> build_info (anchor override as Executor.execute) -> bundle_core
bundle.parse: kpct_core.parse_json of the executed record + 'anchor' (P_0's anchor entity or null) + 'anchor_mention' when P_0 fixed one
bundle.candidates: first 20 pool candidates in RULE order with RULE rank (1-based pool position) and operator_satisfied; s_score = null; s_rank = RULE-order rank (the RULE rank is placed in the slot S occupies at k > 0)
bundle.facts: 20 provenance facts (mtq_export.provenance_facts recipe) following RULE order
bundle.integrity: per row: re-executed RULE list == P_0 prediction list (asserted; dry run 5/5)
bundle.p0_invalid_rows: empty bundle (parse {}, no candidates, no facts) rendered 'Parse: none (...)'; ranked list = [answer] + [] (P_0's empty list)
bundle.no_train_artefact: no S score, classifier, sector alias, block list or train statistic

G_0.decoding: greedy, max 48 new tokens, seed 0; 2,048-token prompt+answer cap with trailing fact groups dropped first (as gk_common.fit_g_prompt)
G_0.output: as G_k: gk_common.canon_answer validity / canonicalisation; ranked list = gk_common.g_ranked(answer, P_0 list); invalid answer stays at rank 1; invalid rate reported
G_0.selection: best dev_sel2000 Hits@1 (hit count); tie -> shortest prompt (fixed-text chars g1 385 < g2 1,228 < g3 1,633)

primary_llm_arm_k0: criteria.primary_llm_arm: P_0 vs G_0 on dev_sel2000 Hits@1; |difference| < 0.0005 -> G_0; declared in the freeze before the test pass
implementation_details: Engine (both arms): vLLM 0.10.2 in tkgqa-vllm:latest, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct bf16, tensor_parallel_size=2, gpu_memory_utilization=0.90, max_model_len=4096, enforce_eager=True, disable_custom_all_reduce=True (B1), enable_prefix_caching=True (as p0_infer_70b.py), seed 0; docker --ipc=host --shm-size=16g, VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn, NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.

k0_infer_70b.py replaces p0_infer_70b.py only to add on-disk shards of 4,000 prompts (rule STOP_HOST: inference in shards); P_0 prompt token ids are built by the same calls (pk_common.encode_prompt(tok, p0_user(head, question))) and the raw output format is unchanged, so p0_execute.py consumes it as is.
One TP2 session per (arm, split): dev_sel2000 decodes all 3 designs in one session; test decodes the selected design only, after the pre-test freeze.
Selection CI: Poisson(1) bootstrap B = 1000 seed 0 (descriptive, as the guided and parser tracks); every design's dev_sel2000 record is appended to multitq_kpct_k0_selection_log.jsonl as computed.
STOP_DEV_FAILURE (best < 0.30 or invalid > 0.20): the driver stops before any test pass (exit 5); one logged bug-fix iteration then needs an amendment.
STOP_BUDGET: before each GPU step, usage log spend + the step's projected GPU-h must be <= 52 (projections from the B1 stage-0 rates: P_0 dev 0.85, P_0 test 7.30, G_0 dev 0.95, G_0 test 8.10).
GPU guard: both cards < 2,000 MiB used, own stale k0_* containers stopped, nothing else touched; usage log rows track 'k0' via run_card_k0.sh (container wall-clock x 2 cards).

G_0 dev bundles are built from P_0's selected dev parses after the P_0 selection; G_0 test bundles from P_0's frozen test parses after the P_0 test freeze; both bundle files are hashed in the G_0 pre-test freeze.

projected_gpu_h.note: consistent with the post-core re-projection (P_0 8.103, G_0 9.022)

cpu_dry_run.inputs: first 5 dev_sel2000 quids; question text from the k01_s0 structural dev bundles (no gold field); placeholder answers; stand-in P_0 generations = k01_s0 structural top-1 parses serialised to compact JSON (4) + 1 non-JSON row; stand-in G_0 generations exercising canonicalisation (valid name, verbose sentence, lower-case/underscore variant, date, empty)

results.every_stage: ran: prompts (tokenizer only) -> stand-in raw -> p0_execute -> select (mock) -> pre-test freeze -> test stand-in -> exec -> test freeze (hash re-verification passed) -> bundles -> G_0 prompts -> post -> select (mock) -> freezes

cpu_dry_run.note: mock scores are 0 by construction and are not dev scores; no real dev answer and no test file was read; the dry tree is WORK_DIR/k0/dry/ (separate from the real outputs)
